page.content:
Tragedy of the king who divides a kingdom and walks into the storm.

How King Lear connects

  • Character: King Lear (character) — Lear is the title king of King Lear.
  • Creator: William Shakespeare — William Shakespeare wrote King Lear.
  • Character: Cordelia — Cordelia is the daughter Lear casts out and later mourns.
  • Concept: Shakespearean tragedy — King Lear is a central Shakespearean tragedy.

What is King Lear?

King Lear is the abdication play: a king who asks his daughters how much they love him, casts out Cordelia, and goes mad on a heath while the state splits around him.

Key threads lead to King Lear (character), William Shakespeare, Cordelia and Shakespearean tragedy.
